test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 26 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which Indian musician won a Grammy twice for Danny Boyle’s film Slumdog Millionaire in 2010?
solution:
The correct answer is __AR Rahman__.

__
 
• AR Rahman won twice in the same year for his work on 'Slumdog Millionaire' taking home two Grammys: Best Song Written for Visual Media and Best Compilation Soundtrack Album For Visual Media.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__

__
 
• Among his long list of accolades are two Oscar Awards, and two Grammy Awards. Speaking of Grammys, the singer won two titles in 2008 in the 'Best Compilation Soundtrack Album' and 'Best Song Written for Visual Media' category for the Oscar-winning film 'Slumdog Millionaire'.
 
• Sitar maestro Pandit Ravi Shankar was the first Indian to win the Grammy Award.
 
• AR Rahman is one of the most prominent musical geniuses in India.
 
• The 64th Annual Grammy Awards took place today in Las Vegas. With several renowned personalities from music in attendance, MGM Garden Grand Arena witnessed a star-studded affair as they put their best foot forward on the red carpet.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• The Grammy Award, or just Grammy, is an award presented by the Recording Academy to recognize "Outstanding Achievement in the music industry" of the United States.
 
• The trophy depicts a gilded gramophone.
 
• The Grammys are the first of the Big Three networks' major music awards held annually.
 
• There is no money related to winning a Grammy. It is just an honor that increases an artist's profile.
 
• The process of voting for GRAMMY Award nominees includes hundreds of music experts in various genres.
